scientific_integrity: Exact elementary isometry proof and reproducible finite checks; no claim of independent proof certification or exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Applies to degree four with odd 2-adic parameter only; does not classify other Dickson degrees, even parameters, or odd-prime modulus images. Exact value counts at all dyadic levels and fiber formula at levels at least five.
title: Three dyadic image phases for quartic Dickson polynomials of the second kind
